prompt: Review the code under after/ in this directory for bugs. Focus on security and correctness.

ground_truth.description: SQL injection via string concatenation in searchOrders — orgId/keyword interpolated directly into the query template string instead of parameterized placeholders
Missing org-scope filter in getOrderById — query drops org_id, allowing cross-org IDOR (any org can read any other org's order by guessing/enumerating orderId)
N+1 query in getOrderItemsForOrders — issues one order_items query per order inside the loop instead of a single batched query (e.g. WHERE order_id = ANY($1)) like before/src/orders-service.ts does
